default_deployment.image_or_version: docker.m.daocloud.io/apache/hertzbeat:1.8.0; upstream apache/hertzbeat:1.8.0; image id sha256:1ffeef8f0dce79c971943e19d2de1ef94f49d5079d0ceebe5292542d65eb63cb; mirror digest sha256:75d48a62748fe42e4b2354e393ce567f51f7d46764b404763ec885cd23d74a0d
config_changes: No HertzBeat source or application configuration changes.
Harness-only host port mapping changed to 2157/2158.
Strict retest harness Docker memory and swap cap set to 2g.
Strict retest harness set JAVA_OPTS=-Xms1g -Xmx1g -XX:MaxDirectMemorySize=1g; --add-opens preserves Apache Arrow Java 21 runtime compatibility.

steps: Wait for GET / on port 1157 to return HTTP 200.
Send anonymous minimal Prometheus text push requests with unique job and instance path segments.

trigger.bandwidth_notes: Eight concurrent local HTTP workers sent minimal Prometheus text bodies with unique job/instance path segments. The run was manually stopped after confirmed 1GiB direct-memory OOM and repeated push 502 responses.

resource_observation.metric: docker memory, Java RSS, Java heap/direct-memory OOM logs, HTTP status, availability

peak.push_plane: sampled push responses included repeated HTTP 502 after direct-memory OOM while GET / stayed HTTP 200

resource_observation.failure_signal: OutOfMemoryError: Cannot reserve 4194304 bytes of direct buffer memory (allocated: 1070396417, limit: 1073741824)

utilization_conditions.summary: 默认 HertzBeat 1.8.0 Docker 部署中，匿名客户端可访问 Prometheus push path；在 2g 容器、1g heap/direct 的严格补测下，约 21.7k 个唯一 job/instance 的最小 push 请求触发目标 JVM direct-buffer `OutOfMemoryError`，push 面出现重复 HTTP 502。
limits_or_mitigations: This run used a 2GiB Docker memory cap and explicit 1GiB Java heap/direct memory as a strict validation harness; larger production containers may require more unique job/instance keys before OOM.
No authentication, rate limit, per-IP quota, job/instance cardinality cap, or eviction was observed on the tested push path.
The controller returned HTTP 400 for many successful side-effect requests, but logs confirmed monitor auto-creation before/around the response.
Disabling unauthenticated push auto-create or bounding job/instance cardinality mitigates this path.
not_affected_when: /api/push/** is not exposed to low-trust clients or is protected by authentication.
Prometheus push auto-create is disabled or constrained.
Unique job/instance cardinality is capped per tenant, user, or source IP.
Created push monitors are evicted or quota-managed.
Reverse proxy or gateway rate limits prevent the required request volume.

static_traceability.driver: attacker-controlled unique job and instance path segments
missing_static_evidence: No proof of external reverse-proxy/body/rate limits in a packaged deployment

notes: 2026-06-30 reinforcement excluded one invalid JAVA_OPTS attempt that omitted Apache Arrow --add-opens and caused MemoryUtil initialization errors.
The fixed 1GiB heap/direct run auto-created 21763 push monitors and logged 180 OutOfMemoryError occurrences before manual stop.
